entities.summary: Florencia Natasha Busquets Reyes is an Argentine volleyball player who participated with the Argentina national team at the Pan-American Volleyball Cup, the FIVB Volleyball World Grand Prix, the 2011 FIVB Volleyball Women's World Cup in Japan, the 2014 FIVB Volleyball Women's World Championship in Italy, the 2018 FIVB Volleyball Women's World Championship, and the 2016 Summer Olympics in Brazil.
